appOverview: Configuración is reached from Dashboard's settings-menu (which stops being a disabled placeholder) and is two separate top-level views, not one: app-teacher-settings-view (/configuracion/profesor — edit the signed-in teacher's full name; change password with current-password confirmation) and app-academic-year-settings-view (/configuracion/ano-academico — full CRUD on ciclos formativos, on their módulos profesionales — each tagged with a curso 1º/2º/3º — and on años académicos; plus, per año académico, which of the teacher's módulos apply that year). Each has its own Shadow DOM (CLAUDE.md's 'no nested Shadow DOM' rule) and is reached by a plain nav link (teacher-nav-link / academic-year-nav-link) rendered identically on both screens via one shared function, not a shared nested component. Everything is scoped to the signed-in teacher and persists immediately to Postgres — no draft/publish step. Every table in the Año académico screen follows lib/patterns/crud-table-component.md: inline editing, dependency-blocked deletion decided server-side. The one deliberate exception to that pattern's 'never a modal' rule is module-edit-confirm-modal, a save-time confirmation gate (not an edit-interaction modal) for editing a módulo already selected by one or more años académicos. **Reopened 2026-07-30**: the Año académico screen now has three modes instead of four always-visible sections — normal mode (selecting a año académico cascades to a filtered training-cycle-table then a filtered module-table, both derived from that year's módulo selection; module-selection-table/module-selection-save-button are hidden), adding-year mode (academic-year-table-add-button — training-cycle-table shows the full list, module-selection-table replaces module-table, one Guardar selección both creates the year and persists the selection), and adding-cycle mode (a new ciclo created in normal mode — same module-selection-table takeover, scoped to it, persisting only the selection since the año académico already exists). module-cycle-select is removed — training-cycle-table's own row click already selects the ciclo.

elementSpecs.behavior: Lists every año académico the teacher has created, inline-editable (rename), with an action per row to mark it 'en curso' and one to delete it. The row marked 'en curso' is selected by default on load. Selecting a row cascades: reloads training-cycle-table filtered to that year's ciclos, then (once it auto-selects its first row) module-table filtered to that ciclo's módulos for this year. Clicking academic-year-table-add-button opens a draft row (name only, no per-row Guardar) and switches training-cycle-table/module-table/module-selection-table into adding-year mode.
businessRules: Año académico nombre is unique per teacher — a duplicate rename/create is rejected server-side and the row's inline error shows why
Marking a row 'en curso' un-marks whichever row was previously current (exactly one current at a time, or none)
Deleting the row currently marked 'en curso' is rejected server-side (dependency-blocked deletion pattern) — academic-year-delete-blocked-message shows the rejection
Deleting a non-current año académico is unrestricted — it doesn't cascade-block anything else (only ciclos/módulos are protected by references, not the año académico row itself)

The draft row opened by academic-year-table-add-button has no independent Guardar — its name is only persisted together with the selection, by module-selection-save-button — only Cancelar is available on it, and cancelling discards the whole in-progress selection too

globalRules: This is two separate top-level custom elements (app-teacher-settings-view, app-academic-year-settings-view), each its own Shadow DOM, each its own route — never one nested inside the other, and never a shared component nesting either of them. Shared nav markup (teacher-nav-link/academic-year-nav-link) comes from one plain function called by both, per CLAUDE.md's Web Components rules
Both screens require a valid session — no session redirects to /login, same gate as Dashboard
Everything (ciclos, módulos, años académicos, their selections) is scoped to the signed-in teacher only — no cross-teacher visibility, no admin/shared catalog

Every table follows lib/patterns/crud-table-component.md: inline editing (never a separate edit form/modal — the one exception is module-edit-confirm-modal, a save-time confirmation gate, not an edit-interaction modal), and dependency-blocked deletion decided server-side (the component only requests a delete, the service decides and responds with success or a named reason)
Uniqueness, all scoped per teacher: ciclo nombre; módulo nombre within its (ciclo, curso); año académico nombre
Exactly one año académico can be marked 'en curso' at a time, or none — never more than one
Deleting the año académico marked 'en curso' is blocked; deleting a ciclo or módulo referenced by any año académico's selection (past or current) is blocked
There are no start/end dates on an año académico — just its nombre — out of scope for this view
